description: This file defines a cross-platform GatewayService interface with platform-specific implementations for managing system services like launch agents, scheduled tasks, and systemd services. It includes functions for reading service state, starting services, and describing restart outcomes.

methods.name: ignoreServiceWriteResult
methods.description: Wraps a service write function to ignore its result and return a Promise that resolves to void.

methods.name: mergeGatewayServiceEnv
methods.description: Merges environment variables from base environment and command configuration.

methods.name: readGatewayServiceState
methods.description: Reads the current state of a GatewayService, including whether it is installed, loaded, and running.

methods.name: startGatewayService
methods.description: Attempts to start or restart the GatewayService, returning the outcome and updated state.

methods.name: describeGatewayServiceRestart
methods.description: Provides a human-readable description of the restart result for a GatewayService.

methods.name: isSupportedGatewayServicePlatform
methods.description: Checks if the current platform is supported for GatewayService.

methods.name: resolveGatewayService
methods.description: Returns the platform-specific GatewayService implementation based on current process platform.
